items.title: Shirley Lewis Interview, 1969-03-25
items.q: Yes, by him and my father being very close. So, from what I understand, when I first started walking, he said, come to Uncle Lawrence, and from then on, it's been Uncle Lawrence.

ctx.x: You call, you refer to Uncle Lawrence, did you think of him as an uncle?
Yes, by him and my father being very close. So, from what I understand, when I first started walking, he said, come to Uncle Lawrence, and from then on, it's been Uncle Lawrence.
Did you know him very well, Lawrence? Did you get to know him very well?
